subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Convert
solution:
The correct answer is **'Transform'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Convert **means to change from one form, system, or use to another.

 **• Example- ***I mus**t convert** my sorrow into my strength.*

 
• Marked option **Transform** means to change completely the appearance or character of something or someone.

 ** • Example- ***A little paint will **transform** this old car.*

 
• So, it is clear that **Convert** and **Transform** are similar in meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dazzle** means to impress somebody very much.
 
• **Radical** means very new and different from the usual or ordinary.
 
• **Affect** means to influence someone or something, rather than to cause something.
